decision.reason: The computed diff lists added enum values ["escalation","schedule","team","teams","user"] for this field and no removed ones. It does not say whether the field had an enum or was unconstrained in v0.85.0. The schema excerpts [ev-3cc85997b394] and [ev-197df9b33168] are empty ("---"), so I can't check the before/after schema. The semvalidate.crd validator also says the enum of this field is unchanged between the releases, which contradicts the diff. I need the actual enum or schema of spec.receivers[].opsgenieConfigs[].responders[].type in both releases before I can tell whether any value that used to be accepted is now rejected (resource-rejected) or whether nothing changed in practice.
